description: Current total value locked (TVL, USD) of one DeFi protocol from DefiLlama, by protocol slug (e.g. aave, uniswap-v3). Returns the single current TVL number only; chain breakdown and history are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_defillama_yields when you need DeFi pool APY, TVL, 7/30-day APY change; crypto_defillama_stablecoins when you need Stablecoin market cap, 1/7/30-day circulating change, peg. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

protocol.description: DefiLlama protocol slug, lowercase letters, digits and dashes
